nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: Still here, Mr Calloway. Officially I'm 'delayed by weather'. Unofficially, I've developed a professional interest in how a railroad baron affords quite so many statues.

choices.text: Careful. He'll commission one of you.

nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: He offered. I declined. My likeness works for a living.

nodes.speaker: The Kestrel
nodes.text: Numbers that don't add and a sheriff who can't subtract. If you happened to be planning something at that gala of his... I happened not to hear about it.
